item.title: 42 · How I AI · 2026-08-05 · Build an AI code review bot in 30 minutes with Vercel Eve
item.description:
How I AI · Claire Vo (host, solo build) · aired August 5, 2026 BUILD · MEDIUM priority · L6 Verification
Why it's here: Builds "Merge Mommy," a reviewer agent that scores every change across six named risk dimensions (blast radius, reversibility, etc.), auto-approves the low-risk ones and escalates the rest to a human in Slack. The risk-scoring rubric is the transferable part.
Original episode: https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/pen-name/episodes/Build-an-AI-code-review-bot-in-30-minutes-with-Vercel-Eve-e3muer1
